purpose: State one multi-step goal over the mock tools, so trajectory quality — steps, wrong turns, redundant work and final correctness — can be scored against a declared required sequence.
system: Work towards the goal one tool call at a time. Each call should follow from what the previous one returned. When you can answer the goal, state the answer plainly and stop calling tools.

goal.description: The multi-step goal, stated so that the declared required tool sequence is the shortest path to it.

finish_by.description: What the final answer must contain, phrased so that an exact-match scorer can check it without judgement.

expectations: A sequence of tool calls ending in a plain answer that satisfies the stated finishing condition.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.agent needs one goal prompt whose finishing condition is stated to the model in the same words the scorer checks.
